passive.name: Frostline
passive.description:
# At the start of battle
- ATK 50% 👆, falling by 20% at the end of every turn to a minimum of 10% (Uncancellable)

# Every time this character attacks
- Applies [Cold] to each enemy hit (Max 3 per enemy, Uncancellable)
- [Cold] stays until it reaches 3 stacks or this character is defeated

# At the end of the turn, by each enemy's [Cold] stacks
- 1 stack: ATK and DEF 10% 👇 for 1 turn
- 2 stacks: also disables ultimate moves for 1 turn
- 3 stacks: removes all [Cold], then [Frozen] for 1 turn
